description: This file implements a Webex video API adapter, including OAuth token management, meeting creation, deletion, updating, and fetching availability, with schema validation and credential handling.

methods.name: webexAuth
methods.description: Handles OAuth token refresh and credential management for Webex API.

methods.name: translateEvent
methods.description: Converts a CalendarEvent to Webex meeting format.

methods.name: fetchWebexApi
methods.description: Performs authenticated fetch requests to Webex API endpoints.

methods.name: invalidateCredential
methods.description: Marks a credential as invalid in the database.
